mechanism: Nafcillin may displace furosemide from protein binding and competitively inhibit renal tubular secretion, reducing furosemide efficacy; concurrent use also increases risk of hypokalemia and ototoxicity.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly, assess diuretic effectiveness, and monitor renal function; consider alternative antibiotics if possible or adjust furosemide dosing based on clinical response.
